title: Heatmap
intent: Create a rectangular cell chart that maps two discrete positions and a quantitative value to color.
useWhen: Use this recipe when values should be compared across a two-dimensional categorical or binned grid.
avoidWhen: Avoid this recipe when empty cells or continuous positions would make the rectangular grid misleading.
prerequisites: Provide immutable row objects containing every field named by the selected actions and example program.
Use explicit public resource identifiers whenever current program state contains more than one compatible candidate.

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: An array of plain row objects containing the fields required by this task.

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: Task-specific field names, resource identifiers, and supported visual or statistical choices.

outcomes: Create a rectangular cell chart that maps two discrete positions and a quantitative value to color.

steps.instruction: Create the data, marks, encodings, and owned resources required before authoring the heatmap result.
Apply the primary action that produces the recognizable heatmap result or workflow.
Add only the supporting encodings, marks, and owned resources needed for the requested heatmap variant.

alternatives.when: Choose a neighboring recipe when its stated result and data roles match the requested chart more directly.
alternatives.instruction: Prefer one complete domain facade or task recipe before composing lower-level actions manually.

pitfalls.problem: Implicit targeting fails when several compatible datasets, marks, scales, guides, or owners exist in the same program.
pitfalls.fix: Pass the exact public identifier named by the action signature instead of relying on first-resource selection.
